newsitem.title: USA: EIS sees Q3 charge of about $0.09/shr.
newsitem.headline: EIS sees Q3 charge of about $0.09/shr.

text.p: EIS International Inc said Friday it expected its Surefind operating company to have a one-time expense in the third quarter that could reduce earnings per share by about $0.09.
The company said the selling, general and administrative expense (SG&A) involved its marketing launch of Surefind.
It said it would write the expense off as a result of the cancellation of the direct consumer marketing program.

EIS International is the parent corporation for three operating companies, one of them being Surefind, which offers an on-line data back-up and recovery service for personal computer and laptop users as well as small businesses.
